findings.title: Direct provider API calls in emergency alert bypass model router

evidence.observation: Direct invocation of call_gemini and call_mistral bypassing the centralized model router

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM requests through the model router endpoints to preserve centralized policy, fallbacks, and telemetry.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures consistent rate-limiting, error handling, and latency observability across emergency alerting.

findings.title: Model router call log file does not exist

evidence.observation: call_log_exists is false and recent_avg_ms is null despite router being reachable

proposed_action.description: Verify model router logging path and ensure call_log.jsonl is created with appropriate write permissions.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores model routing telemetry, request metrics, and latency analysis.

findings.title: Recent invocation failures recorded by model router

evidence.observation: router_status reports 5 recent failed calls with 0 active loaded models in Ollama

proposed_action.description: Inspect recent failure exceptions in model router and ensure required local models are loaded or cloud fallbacks are active.

findings.expected_benefit: Prevents upstream request failures and degradation of LLM dependent platform features.

findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 placeholders in platform runtime research commands

evidence.observation: Unimplemented Phase 5 TODOs for Supabase authorization and decision_to_memory integration
Empty list placeholder for quality_anomalies query in quality_forecasting

proposed_action.description: Implement the missing Phase 5 authorization, memory integration hooks, and quality_anomalies table queries.

findings.expected_benefit: Completes research command workflows and enables accurate forecasting based on historical anomalies.
